decisions.reason: It fits the firm's push into compliance services, stayed visible on its own page through 2024, and as an adjacent software line in a medium-sized portfolio it still has option value that likely outweighs its carrying cost.
As the flagship web hosting management platform shown on the home page in both years and central to the firm's stated direction, it is a core strategic option the firm is very unlikely to abandon.

A configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the established business, remained actively marketed in 2024, and likely uses existing infrastructure efficiently, so keeping it is the more attractive choice.

Although still new and only lightly evidenced, extended PHP security support is a low-cost, high-fit add-on tied to the firm's security and support strengths, so management would likely keep it while uncertainty resolves.
